subject: english
question:
**Given below are four sentences which are jumbled. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. The sectors included agriculture, public health and public utilities among others.

B. The GGI framework covered 10 sectors and 58 Industries.

C. The Good Governance Index (GGI) 2021 scores have been declared.

D. The objective was to provide quantifiable data to compare the performance of different States and Union Territories in these sectors.
solution:
The correct answer is "**CBAD**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the given passage.
 
• **Statement C **is the first sentence of the passage as it delineates the **theme **of the given passage which is the **Good Governance Index (GGI) 2021.**
 
• **Statement B **is the second sentence of the passage as it talks about the **GGI framework covering 10 sectors and 58 Industries**. This is the practical application of the objectives stated in the previous statement.
 
• **Statement A** is the third sentence of the passage as it talks about the** various sectors which are included.** The previous statement ended by talking about different sectors and industries in the GGI framework.
 
• **Statement D** is the last sentence of the passage as the statement begins by stating what the objective was. It was done to provide quantifiable data to compare the performance of different States and Union Territories in these sectors.

Hence, the correct sequence is "**CBAD**"

**The complete passage is:* C****. The Good Governance Index (GGI) 2021 scores have been declared. **B**. The GGI framework covered 10 sectors and 58 Industries. **A**. The sectors included agriculture, public health and public utilities among others. **D**. The objective was to provide quantifiable data to compare the performance of different States and Union Territories in these sectors.*
